raylib.label: raylib-cpp (baseline)
raylib.game: Copy of the checkout-B fishing game (C++ / raylib-cpp), configured once with the same toolchain Studio's C++ lane uses.
raylib.preamble: This is a fishing game in C++ with raylib-cpp. Edit only its source files under src/. Do not run the build; it is run for you after your reply.

asks.text: Add a second kind of fish. It bites half as often as the current one, but a catch is worth three points. Show which kind was caught for a moment after each catch.
When a fish bites, draw an expanding ripple ring on the water around the bobber that fades out over about one second.
Make the game a 60-second round: show the time left in the HUD, stop casting when it reaches zero, and show the final score with a key or tap to start a new round.
Add wind that changes every 10 seconds and pushes each cast sideways. Show its direction and strength as an arrow in the HUD.
Add a shop item: a better rod that costs 5 points and shortens the wait for a bite by a third. It can be bought once; show it as owned afterwards.
Add a combo: catches less than 10 seconds apart raise a multiplier (x2, x3, up to x5) that applies to the points of each catch. Show the multiplier in the HUD and reset it when the window passes.
